title: Longest Palindromic Substring
prompt: Given a string `s`, return the longest substring of `s` that is a palindrome. If there are multiple longest palindromic substrings, return any one of them.

examples.explanation: "aba" is also a valid answer of the same length.
A single character is trivially a palindrome of itself, the minimum-length input allowed by the constraints.

constraints: s consists of digits and English letters
hints: A palindrome mirrors around its center. There are only 2n-1 possible centers in a string of length n (n single-character centers, n-1 between-character centers).
For each possible center, expand outward in both directions as long as the characters match — this is the 'expand around center' technique and runs in O(n^2) total.
Try both an odd-length center (single character) and an even-length center (between two characters) for every index, and keep track of the longest palindrome found across all expansions.

solution.approach: For every index in the string, treat it as the center of an odd-length palindrome and also as the left side of an even-length palindrome's center, expanding outward from each while the characters on both sides match. Track the longest palindrome found across all 2n-1 possible centers. This 'expand around center' approach runs in O(n^2) time with O(1) extra space.
